recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞樣細胞核內有一個圓形、淡粉紅色的包涵體，看似位於核內並將染色質推向周邊，即 Dutcher body；背景混有小淋巴球、漿細胞樣淋巴球與漿細胞，符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Arrowed plasmacytoid cell with a round, pale eosinophilic, sharply delineated intranuclear (pseudo)inclusion - Dutcher body
Mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs
Scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei and occasional mast cell/histiocyte-like cells
Scattered red cells and fat spaces in marrow/tissue section
No sheets of large atypical cells in this field
describe_en: Section shows a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells. A plasmacytoid cell (arrow) contains a well-circumscribed, pale eosinophilic intranuclear inclusion, consistent with a Dutcher body, which represents cytoplasmic immunoglobulin invaginating into or overlying the nucleus. No sheets of large transformed cells are seen in this field. In the clinical setting of recurrent disease, the findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma; immunophenotyping and MYD88 L265P testing support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Also can show Dutcher bodies, but features monocytoid B cells and marginal zone/lymphoepithelial architecture and usually lacks MYD88 L265P.
Consists of sheets of monomorphic plasma cells without a clonal small B-lymphocyte component, and is CD20-negative.
Russell bodies are cytoplasmic eosinophilic globules that do not overlie the nucleus, often multiple, and occur in reactive plasma cells too.
Artifactual clear spaces are empty rather than containing homogeneous eosinophilic PAS-positive immunoglobulin.
